title: Correct Definitions
description: Essential Criteria: Each pair must have an accurate and concise definition of their contributions to physics.

title: Key Concepts
description: Important Criteria: Responses should include key concepts or principles related to the contributions of each pair.

title: Equation Inclusion
description: Optional Criteria: If applicable, include relevant equations associated with the contributions.

title: Clarity of Expression
description: Important Criteria: The response should be clearly articulated and easy to understand.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for common errors such as misattributing contributions or omitting key details.
